# Milhaus

> Milhaus (www.milhaus.de) is a marketplace for Americans living in Germany — U.S. military service members, DoD civilians, their families, and expats. In one place it lists homes for rent and for sale, cars, trusted local businesses, special offers from those businesses, and community events, centred on the areas around U.S. bases: Stuttgart, Kaiserslautern, Ramstein, Wiesbaden, Grafenwöhr and Spangdahlem.

Milhaus is independent. It is not run by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any military installation's Housing Office or the U.S. Department of Defense.

Key facts:
- Homes and cars are posted by the people renting or selling them: landlords, property managers and families moving out (PCS).
- Every listing stays up for 30 days at a time and comes down when it's rented or sold; posters renew it if it's still available.
- Homes for rent can be marked "US Military only" or "US Military & Expats"; homes for sale are open to anyone.
- Car prices are shown in US dollars, home prices in euros.
- Businesses only appear in the directory after the business itself confirms it agrees to be listed.
- The site is in English, with a German version at /de.
- Contact: info@milhaus.de

## Homes
- [Homes for rent](https://www.milhaus.de/listings): Houses and apartments for rent near U.S. bases in Germany, filterable by base, bedrooms, price, features (garage, garden, pet friendly…) and who the home is available to.
- [Homes for sale](https://www.milhaus.de/listings?for=sale): Houses for sale near U.S. bases, listed by their owners — often families selling before a PCS move.
- [For landlords](https://www.milhaus.de/for-landlords): How owners and property managers list homes on Milhaus.

## Cars
- [Cars for sale](https://www.milhaus.de/cars): Cars sold by Americans in Germany — often U.S.-spec cars sold before a move. Filterable by make, year, body type, transmission and US/EU spec.

## Services
- [Military-friendly businesses](https://www.milhaus.de/services): A directory of local businesses that serve the American community — car dealers, movers, repair shops, real estate and more — organised by base and city.
- [Special Offers](https://www.milhaus.de/offers): Current promotions from local businesses.

## Events
- [Events calendar](https://www.milhaus.de/events): Upcoming community events near U.S. bases, with a link to each organiser.

## For businesses
- [Advertise on Milhaus](https://www.milhaus.de/advertise): Banner, Cars-page sidebar and Special Offers ad spots, bought for 30 days up to several years, online or by invoice.
